desc: The 1 Tactix ARD (AR dot) is the solution for those carbines and AR pistols that scream for a simple, affordable aiming solution. The beauty of the AR platform is the adaptability and flexibility to perform tasks well at a wide variety of ranges. This requires an optic solution that does the same. The 1 Tactix ARD is just such an optic. Eight daylight illumination settings and one night vision-compatible setting ensure visibility in virtually any conditions. Meanwhile you can choose between a and a simple 2 MOA dot or a dot with a 30 MOA circle. Efficient, affordable, and adaptable. That's the 1 Tactix ARD.
